title: Synthetic Philippine life insurance renewal demo
content: This prototype demonstrates a Philippine life-insurance renewal conversation only. It names no real insurer, policy, product benefit, premium, coverage amount, or rider offer. Ask an authorized insurer representative for actual product information.

title: Demo renewal review window
content: For this synthetic demonstration only, a renewal review may begin 30 days before the demo renewal date. This is not a real insurance rule; the actual policy schedule and insurer notice control.

title: Demo renewal qualification fields
content: The synthetic agent may record renewal intent as yes, no, or still considering, and may note a preferred callback window. It must not determine eligibility, approve renewal, collect policy numbers, or promise a coverage outcome.
response_text: This demo can note whether you want to renew, do not want to renew, or are still considering. It cannot decide eligibility or approve a renewal, and it will not ask for a policy number.

title: Taglish demo renewal qualification rules
content: Sa demo, itatala lang namin kung gusto mong mag-renew, ayaw munang mag-renew, o pinag-iisipan mo pa. Maaari ring itala ang preferred callback time. Hindi magpapasya ang demo kung eligible ka, hindi ito mag-aapruba ng renewal, at hindi ito hihingi ng policy number.
response_text: Sa demo, maaari kong itala kung gusto mong mag-renew, ayaw mo muna, o pinag-iisipan mo pa. Hindi ako magpapasya kung eligible ka o mag-aapruba ng renewal, at hindi ako hihingi ng policy number.
search_terms: renewal qualification decision eligibility callback intent

title: Mock callback request FAQ
content: A mock callback request can save the customer's preferred time window and a short summary for the demo. It does not schedule a real call and does not ask for a phone number.

title: Responding to a premium cost objection
content: If a customer says a premium seems too expensive or unaffordable, acknowledge the concern. Do not suggest changing coverage or promise a discount. Offer a representative callback to discuss approved options.
response_text: I understand that the premium feels expensive. I can't suggest changing coverage or promise a discount. I can note a callback request if you would like a representative to discuss approved options.

title: Taglish premium concern response
content: Kung mahal ang premium, naiintindihan ko. Hindi tayo magbabago ng coverage o mangangako ng discount. Maaari kitang tulungan mag-request ng callback mula sa representative para talakayin ang approved options.
response_text: Kung mabigat ang premium, naiintindihan ko. Hindi ako magmumungkahi ng pagbabago sa coverage o mangangako ng discount. Maaari kong itala ang callback request kung gusto mong makipag-usap sa representative tungkol sa approved options.
search_terms: premium seems expensive unaffordable cost objection callback

title: Synthetic optional rider discussion
content: The demo can record interest in an optional rider discussion only. Actual rider availability, eligibility, cost, and coverage must be confirmed from the customer's current policy by an authorized representative.

title: Filipino and Taglish renewal phrasing
content: Sa demo na ito, ang rider ay optional na dagdag na benepisyo sa base policy kung available sa kontrata. Ang beneficiary ay taong nakapangalan upang tumanggap ng benepisyo ayon sa policy terms. Iba-iba ang aktuwal na kahulugan at kondisyon depende sa iyong kontrata, kaya representative ang makakakumpirma.
search_terms: Filipino Tagalog Taglish rider beneficiary bank referral premium life insurance

title: Synthetic Indonesian consumer finance reminder

title: Synthetic cicilan and jatuh tempo reminder
content: Demo saja: agen dapat mengingatkan pelanggan untuk memeriksa tanggal jatuh tempo angsuran atau cicilan. Jumlah, tanggal pembayaran, tenor, DP, denda, dan status pembayaran yang sebenarnya tidak tersedia di sini. Konfirmasikan jadwal terbaru kepada penyedia pembiayaan resmi.

title: Indonesian demo qualification and callback fields
content: Untuk demo ini, catat minat pelanggan untuk membahas cicilan dan waktu callback yang dipilih. Jangan menentukan kelayakan, menjanjikan perubahan tenor atau denda, meminta nomor rekening, atau memproses pembayaran.
response_text: Untuk demo ini, saya dapat mencatat minat Anda untuk membahas cicilan dan waktu callback pilihan. Saya tidak dapat menentukan kelayakan, menjanjikan perubahan tenor atau denda, meminta nomor rekening, atau memproses pembayaran.

title: Demo cicilan reminder FAQ
content: Demo pengingat cicilan ini tidak memproses pembayaran atau memastikan status angsuran. Silakan periksa jadwal dan konfirmasikan pembayaran melalui kanal resmi penyedia pembiayaan.
search_terms: Indonesian cicilan reminder demo does not process payment confirm angsuran payment status

title: Response to cicilan payment difficulty and denda concern
content: Jika pelanggan kesulitan membayar cicilan atau khawatir tentang denda, dengarkan tanpa menghakimi. Jangan menjanjikan penghapusan denda atau perubahan tenor. Tawarkan callback petugas pembiayaan untuk memeriksa pilihan resmi.
response_text: Saya paham kalau membayar cicilan terasa sulit. Saya tidak bisa menjanjikan penghapusan denda atau perubahan tenor. Saya dapat mencatat permintaan callback agar petugas memeriksa pilihan resmi.
search_terms: borrower trouble paying cicilan payment difficulty worries penalty fees denda

title: Formal and colloquial Bahasa Indonesia reminder phrasing
content: Selamat pagi, Bapak/Ibu. Ini demo pengingat pembiayaan. Kami tidak bisa melihat jumlah atau tanggal pembayaran Anda. Silakan cek jadwal cicilan dan tanggal jatuh tempo di kanal resmi. Kalau mau, petugas bisa bantu cek tenor, DP, atau angsuran yang sesuai dengan perjanjian Anda.
